column1: # bench/pricing.tsv. Confirm before use.
# Source: https://claude.com/pricing, fetched 2026-09-22. Figures copied from
# .capstan/effort/scout/session-log-format.md, section 7. Confidence there is
# marked medium. The fetch was summarised by a tool rather than quoted from
# the page verbatim. One unrelated web search returned different numbers for
# a different-generation model it called "Sonnet 4.6". Re-check the live page
# before trusting a run's cost total.
# The pricing page quoted one cache-write figure per model, not a 5-minute and
# a 1-hour figure separately. cache_write_5m_per_mtok holds that figure.
# cache_write_1h_per_mtok is left blank because no source gives a separate
# 1-hour rate. session-usage treats a blank rate as unpriced for that
# component and marks the total partial rather than guessing the 5-minute
# rate applies.
# The model column must match a session's message.model string exactly, or
# session-usage reports that model as unpriced rather than guessing a match.
# claude-sonnet-5, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-fable-5-1 below are real
# message.model strings. Confirmed by grepping for "model":"claude- across
# ~/.claude/projects/ on 2026-09-22.
# claude-opus-5 also appears in real transcripts, but the only sourced price
# found is for Opus 5.5, a different model. claude-opus-5 has no row here and
# prints unpriced until a source prices it.
# claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 has a sourced price but no transcript on this
# machine confirms that exact model string. Treat its row as unconfirmed.
